_help: Copy to music-links.json (gitignored), put links under "links", then run `npm run sync` (or `npm run add` then `npm run publish`). Only url is required: title, artist, series and year are guessed from YouTube when left out, and song times come from "chapters", else the video's own chapters, else one song for the whole video. Imported links get "status": "imported".
